findings.title: Failed legacy alias cleanup resurrects a later accepted neutral preference
findings.reproduction: Seed legacy preview_ai_enabled=false in real isolated Storage. First startup import publishes canonical false but one native os.rename(storage.json) refusal prevents alias deletion. Production PreviewSettings.set(ai,true) succeeds and sparsely removes the canonical leaf. Next startup import restores false, then successfully deletes the stale alias. Genuine production-owner probe probes/legacy-neutral-real-storage.lua passes on actual LuaJIT and Lua5.4; successful-delete control preserves true.
findings.root_cause: linux/infra/legacy_hotstring_storage.lua:284,293 commits/adopts canonical state before separate storage.delete loop:295-300. Startup linux/ergopti_hotstrings.lua:881 ignores false. The next importer fills absent canonical leaves (:270), while a later valid neutral choice intentionally deletes its leaf (linux/infra/hotstring_preferences.lua:293). No durable committed-import retirement prevents old alias authority from winning again.
findings.silent_failure: Initial alias cleanup failure is logged. The later neutral menu operation returns true and next import reports success, silently superseding that newer choice. Existing importer tests cover config publication refusal but not committed import plus failed alias retirement plus later sparse edit.
findings.regression_test: Exercise true production Storage/Importer/Preferences with one native storage deletion publication failure, then accepted neutral menu edit and fresh boot. Preserve neutral, explicit nonneutral config precedence and unrelated source tokens; cover partial key retirement and successful deletion controls.

findings.title: Rejected locale change remains canonical startup authority after native alias refusal
findings.additional_property: Truthful persistence failure receipts and consistency of rejected choice with canonical startup authority; synchronous Linux manifestation of macOS MCF-001, deduplicate the integrated root.
findings.reproduction: Private [script] locale fr and real Storage locale fr; initialize real i18n. Refuse only os.rename to storage.json during set_locale(en). Setter returns false and active/native alias stay fr, while canonical file becomes en. Restore native boundary; production script_scope.adopt_configured plus a fresh i18n initialization loads en. Absent canonical row control remains fr. Probe probes/locale-split-commit.lua succeeds under LuaJIT and Lua5.4.
findings.root_cause: linux/infra/i18n.lua:233-236 rewrites existing canonical locale before _save_locale; the native failure returns false with explicit nothing-changed diagnostic and no compensation or accepted saved-intent receipt. Startup linux/infra/script_scope.lua:48-51 adopts the changed canonical row. Actual menu_language.lua:50-54 returns false and refreshes old checked locale.
findings.silent_failure: Native refusal itself is logged, but the message says locale was not persisted and nothing changed. The changed startup authority and later adoption are undisclosed; user sees the old language/check then later receives a rejected selection. This is distinct from Windows explicitly accepted saved-but-reload-refused behavior.
findings.regression_test: Drive genuine menu/i18n, shared authority and native storage with existing/absent canonical locale rows and native write refusal. Require a coherent accepted saved-intent receipt or conditional compensated rejection; ensure fresh startup cannot apply a rejected choice. Preserve source-conflict protection, native aliases, same-locale no-op and successful locale changes.
